comments.text:
No motorbikes on Siargao in 1992 - 

No electricity in General Luna in September, 1992 -

Very few visitors and no one surfing at all.

Tony Arruza and Steve Jones never came near the Tuason Point area in 1980 when they were on Siargao

The first person to carry a surfboard to Siargao Island is generally accepted to be Steve Scott, and American who lived at Subic Bay with his parents, as his father was serving in the US Navy. He traveled to Siargao in 1978.

There is no documentation of Mike Boyum ever having a surfboard on Siargao - he came to the island to hide, not on a vacation!

John Seaton Callahan named the wave "Cloud 9" as documented in Surfer Magazine, March 1993 issue - the first magazine to publish the materials from our September, 1992 project
